The first look shows the record layout. Next I'll parse every line and count the late orders whose customer is in BA.

```repl
import re
lines=[l for l in context.split('\n') if l.strip()]
pat=re.compile(r'\[order (\S+)\] seller=(\S+) \((.*?)\) customer=(\S+)/(.*?) category=(\S+) purchased=(\S+) estimated=(\S+) delivered=(\S*) \((.*?)\) review=(\d)/5 "(.*)"')
recs=[]
bad=0
for l in lines:
    m=pat.search(l)
    if m: recs.append(m.groups())
    else: bad+=1
print(len(lines),len(recs),bad)
ba=[r for r in recs if r[3]=='BA']
print(len(ba))
print(sum(1 for r in ba if 'late' in r[9]))
print(set(r[9].split('(')[0] for r in recs[:0]))
import collections
print(collections.Counter(re.sub(r'\d+','N',r[9]) for r in recs).most_common(10))
```
